items.question: What kind of suffering befalls beings confined within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams?
premises: Beings exist within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
Those womb-diagrams form a fixed set of locations.
Beings located there are subject to torment.
items.inference: Beings in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams endure torment.
uncertainties: The specific nature of the torment remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: In the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
